name: io.github.jordanburke/microsoft-todo-mcp-server
description: Microsoft To Do via Graph — task lists, tasks, checklist items and reminders.

environmentVariables.name: MS_TODO_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Microsoft Graph access token. Must be set together with MS_TODO_REFRESH_TOKEN; `mstodo-config` emits both.

environmentVariables.name: MS_TODO_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Refresh token. Required alongside the access token, but note the env-token path does not renew: once the access token expires the server returns 401 until it is replaced.

environmentVariables.name: CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Azure AD application (client) ID. The server reads it to refresh tokens when the stored token file carries no credentials; `mstodo-setup` also uses it.

environmentVariables.name: CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Azure AD client secret, used for the same token refresh and by `mstodo-setup`.

environmentVariables.name: TENANT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Azure AD tenant: 'organizations' (the default), 'consumers', 'common', or a tenant GUID.
